source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: anatomically correct production horse part atlas. Image1 provides the SAME bay horse identity, realistic fur finish, warm chestnut body, black lowerlegs/mane/tail and black hooves. Make a NEW coordinated 4x4 grid of EXACTLY16 transparent independent horse parts, no labels/numbers/gridlines. Orthographic true RIGHT FACING side view; not threequarter. High detail 3D realistic horse fur, coherent soft daylight from upperleft. Every piece fully inside its cell with generous transparent gutters. Natural rounded skin overlap ends painted fur/scales continuous, no white amputated cutfaces, no hollow sleeves, no spheres or mechanical caps. Do not add legs/head/tail to torso. All sixteen cells equal, no overlap between neighboring parts, canvas1536x1536. Anatomical source parts for a three-segment horse leg; forelimb differs from hindlimb, do not reuse one arbitrary tube for both. Row1 left to right: 1 torso only including rounded rump and scapular chest, neither neck nor limbs; 2 ONE COMPLETE continuous head AND entire long gracefully arched neck reaching broad chest base, natural face eye ears poll black mane and throat, head and neck joined without cap; 3 hindquarter upper thigh, full rounded hip tapering to stifle/knee below and FORWARD; 4 hind tibia/gaskin from stifle to prominent hock, slopes DOWN AND BACK, brown muscular top narrowing into black hock, complete bone segment. Row2: 5 hind cannon/metatarsal black lowerleg hock-to-fetlock, lean long with anatomically narrow midsection, rounded proximal and distal fur overlap; 6 rear dark hoof INCLUDING SHORT SLOPED PASTERN just above hoof, natural generous hoof proportion; 7 entire thick flowing black tail INCLUDING short chestnut fleshy dock at upperright root, down-left flowing fine hair taper, no stumpcap; 8 forelimb scapula/shoulder and upper arm to elbow, rounded muscular brown root, elbow toward rear. Row3: 9 forearm from elbow to carpal knee, chestnut proximal taper to black carpal end, anatomically lean; 10 fore cannon/metacarpal black lowerleg carpus-to-fetlock, natural slender taper and rounded overlap ends; 11 front hoof INCLUDING short sloped pastern; 12 UNUSED alternate complete natural horse muzzle only. Row4: 13 UNUSED alternate head without neck; 14 UNUSED small black mane tuft; 15 UNUSED shoulder fur transition swatch with soft natural rounded contour, no cap; 16 UNUSED hip fur transition swatch with natural rounded contour. Main consumed parts1..11 must be complete, no torso duplicated on thighs, continuous full head-neck cell2. Preserve source horse's natural head/body/hoof proportions, not fantasy chunky or toy shapes. Actual transparency, no shadows outside parts, no text. Artwork should enable elegant realistic horse animation, not a set of disjoint blobs.
